g.text: Genomes and lineages are counted separately. Tiers: post-hoc rule, REPORT 7.2.1. Markers: circle Tier 1, diamond Tier 2, square Tier 3, hollow circle unconfirmed, cross dropped, hollow star candidate.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: C33 + UAA=Stop: Tier 1, 6 genomes (4 fish lineages, 4 origins); Tier 2, 3; Tier 3, 2; unconfirmed, 2; dropped, 1 (14). Tiers 1 and 2: 9 genomes, 6 origins.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: G33 + UAA=Stop: Tier 1, 1 genome; Tier 2, 1 (2 species of 1 genus, Craniella; 1 origin); unconfirmed, 1 (Bufotes) (3). All 17: 11 origins.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: UAA=Tyr, panel, about 5 origins (not new); Plicatula and Radopholus N33 are raw calls below the gate. Non-panel: Rotylenchulus, unconfirmed single-genome candidate.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Background not drawn: 28,566 U33 Stop genomes. Origin counts come from the full taxonomy table, not from this pruned display.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The tree is NCBI taxonomy (phylum to genus), not a molecular phylogeny, so origin counts are approximate; branch lengths have no meaning.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Non-U33 tRNA-Tyr with UAA=Stop, and UAA=Tyr lineages
